summary: HomesToLife Ltd, a Singapore-based furniture retailer listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026 reporting interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements (Exhibit 99.1), management's discussion and analysis (Exhibit 99.2), and a press release announcing the results and a related conference call (Exhibit 99.3). No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory terms are disclosed. This is a routine interim earnings report, not a special situation; monitor guidance and capital/liquidity disclosures for any future strategic action.
